messages:
alex: Need to open a GCP quota request for us-west2 — planning a new high-density GPU nodepool for model serving/training. We hit IP exhaustion during scale tests :grimacing:

maria: Numbers? how many gpus/nodes/pods are we targeting?

alex: Plan = 20 nodes x 4 A100-40GB each (so +80 A100s). We also want higher pods-per-node (we're packing ~100 pods/node for batch inference). Current VPC secondary range is too small and we see alias IP allocation failures.

jordan: I'll draft the support ticket. Are we using VPC-native (alias IP) or custom? Need exact subnet name and current mask.

maria: GKE is VPC-native with alias IP. Current pod secondary range for cluster-redwood-prod is /22 (~1024 IPs) which hits limit when we autoscale the GPU pool.

jordan: Draft for GCP support (will paste):

```
Project: projects/redwood-prod
Region: us-west2
Request: Increase compute and networking quota for GKE GPU nodepool
Details:
- Accelerators (A100 40GB): increase quota from 32 -> 128 in region us-west2
- Expand VPC subnet secondary range for cluster-redwood-prod-gke-pods from /22 -> /19
- Ask for confirmation on recommended max pods-per-node with Alias IP and our CNI setup
Reason: provisioning a dedicated high-density GPU nodepool (20 nodes x 4 A100) for inference and batch workloads. Current tests fail with IP allocation errors and exhausted accelerator quota.
```

sam: Looks good. Also request Cloud NAT external IP quota bump (we use Cloud NAT for egress) — we may need ~30 reserved NAT IPs to support concurrent egress flows during scale.

alex: Add a short note about expected autoscaling characteristics and surge: we plan rolling surge 2, autoscaler target cpu/mem thresholds, but need IP headroom for bursts.

ashley: Finance note: this is a quota increase only — not committing to spend. I'll estimate cost if we hit full utilization and post in thread. :money_with_wings:

devops-bot: cluster-prod-01 alert: pod IP pool exhaustion on nodepool-gpu-test at 1965432085 — 7 failed pod creations in last 5m

jordan: Submitting ticket now. Will include link and escalate if support stalls. cc @maria @ashley

maria: If they ask why /19: explain we need headroom for prod + canary + batch + staging in same VPC, plus room for future nodepools. Also ask them to confirm any downstream impacts to routes or peering.

alex: Once quota is approved we’ll roll out nodepool with maxSurge=2 and enable cluster autoscaler gradual step-up. Plan a short maintenance window for the first rollout. :thumbsup:

jordan: Ticket submitted: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1234567890 — awaiting reply, will escalate after 24h if no update.

sam: Follow-up idea: evaluate pod density alternatives (smaller containers, CRI tweaks, or using Taints+Multiple node sizes) to lower IP pressure. Added to infra backlog.

alex: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. Filing infra backlog ticket after this is closed.
